text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

No problem at all, we can certainly help you next month. A basic service is four hundred ninety nine rupees, and a puncture repair is one hundred twenty rupees. Parts would be extra only after your approval. Would you like me to note this down for when you are ready?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?
Parts are extra only after your approval, and we are open Tuesday to Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM. Would you like to share your preferred name and locality so we can note this enquiry?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
